pilot_scenario.variant: fresh causalman_micro at pinned commit,one product;do not mix Zenodo historic small/medium or other variants
pilot_scenario.nodes: Freeze V* from validated baseline observation schema before fitting;A=PF_M1_T1_Force and Y=Sec_C2_Machine1_ProcessResult must be present and nonconstant in training.If not,stop;do not fabricate/drop target to pass.
pilot_scenario.reference: Validate sampled equation graph against returned DAG per row-producing path/batch;latent-project full verified graph onto the SAME fixed V*.Do not take induced observed DAG.For obs-only use corresponding MAG/PAG adjacency/endpoints and mixed-graph distance,not legacy direct-DAG StrictF1.Projection code presence is not proof of GT validity.
pilot_scenario.discovery: Latent-aware PAG/MAG-compatible discovery with a prespecified valid mixed-data CI test is the appropriate target;no actual algorithm choice/fit here.PC/BOSS/DirectLiNGAM under unmet assumptions would only be diagnostics,not automatically identified causal competitors.
pilot_scenario.intervention_api: sim=CausalMan(name='causalman_micro',seed=s,parallelize=False);sim.intervention_dict={'PF_M1_T1_Force':a};obs,mag,admg,full,dag,int_table=sim.sample(n_samples=N).Source signature only,NOT_RUN.Do not use no-op apply_interventions or broken4-unpack CLI.
pilot_scenario.reference_policy: independent do(force=16000) evaluation,not untreated observational mean
pilot_scenario.target: ProcessResult is1/True for conforming product;actual dtype/schema to verify
pilot_scenario.loss: L(a)=E[1-Y^a] for validated binaryY;failure/nonconformance probability.No invented cost term or lambda;not economic/safety optimization.(1-E[Y])^2 would be a different loss.
pilot_scenario.physical_scope: Ideal hard-do on a force variable in a synthetic production SCM;no evidence it equals a plant's realizable actuator/controller policy or safe force range.Threshold interventions excluded as primary manufacturing-action scenario.
pilot_scenario.split: Disjoint effective-seed namespaces/whole parts,batches and product contexts for Dtrain,Vselect,Rreference,Ffinal.CLI's common seed is not accepted as separation.No row-wise noise pairing from same root seed.
pilot_scenario.sampling_cost_caveat: These are returned row counts only;sample(N) runs >=1 full batch before downsampling. No runtime/RSS/cost promise or download approval.
pilot_scenario.effect: Independent-arm E[Ydo30000]-E[Ydo16000],with uncertainty at batch/part level as appropriate;fixed-policy effect error separate from chosen-policy loss.
pilot_scenario.reference_selection: Choose empirical best of fixed2arms on R only;freeze model and reference choices then compare on untouchedF.Label finite empirical reference selection error,not global continuous optimum.
pilot_scenario.failure: Record generator nonfinite/schema/graph mismatches and stop acceptance;model/identification failure uses declared a0 abstention with availability reported.No arbitrary loss0/large penalty,no selected-sample-only effect.
pilot_scenario.hypothesis_connection: Within validated candidate,associate graph-quality/error patterns with fixed-effect error and quality-choice loss;algorithm/task/batch dependence retained.No TEP7F1 reuse,no manufacturing generalization from1SCM.
